glosses: One who makes dire predictions about the future; one who predicts doom.

examples.text: Even from the doomsayers you hear reflections of hope. Nobody wants "it" to happen. In his darkest moments, man is aware that, while he may be limited, humankind need not be.

examples.text: He ignored the naysayers and succeeded with his idea.

examples.text: There are croakers in every country, always boding its ruin.

They never see the bright side of anything, and probably never will.
